name: cashflow-modern
description: Cashflow board game (Rat Race + Fast Track) — React + TypeScript, realtime on Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects, bilingual TH/EN

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix worker install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n worker,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix worker run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm --prefix worker run dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm --prefix worker run deploy
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm --prefix worker run typecheck
